ImageDescription.value:
After driving through town, I arrived at one of the last businesses, a restaurant/bar. From there you can drive the hard packed sand road down to the beach.

I stop once I got to the beach and went for a refreshing and cleansing swim. After drying off, I continued up to my chosen camp spot and set up the tent.

One of the great conveniences in Chile is that many gas stations offer showers for their patrons to use. It was so civilized for the intrepid car camper.
